questions.question: How many orders are there in total?

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders;

questions.question: How many orders have the status 'canceled'?

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

questions.question: What is the average review score across all reviews? Round to two decimals.

sql.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS average_review_score FROM order_reviews;

questions.answer: The average review score across all reviews is 4.09 (rounded to two decimals).

questions.question: Which payment type is used in the most payments, and in how many payments?

sql.query:
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY payment_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.answer: O tipo de pagamento mais utilizado é credit_card (cartão de crédito) com 76.795 pagamentos.

questions.question: How many sellers are located in the state of Sao Paulo (SP)?

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'SP';

questions.answer: Há 1849 vendedores localizados no estado de São Paulo (SP).

questions.question: Which 5 customer states have the most orders? Give each state and its number of orders, from most to least.

sql.query:
SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS orders_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY orders_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

questions.answer:
Reading used: aggregate orders by customer_state (joining orders with customers) and take the top 5 by count.

Top 5 states by number of orders: SP — 41,746; RJ — 12,852; MG — 11,635; RS — 5,466; PR — 5,045.

questions.question: What is the total freight value of all order items bought by customers in the state of Rio de Janeiro (RJ)?

sql.query:
SELECT SUM(oi.freight_value) AS total_freight_rj
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ';

questions.answer: O valor total do frete de todos os itens de pedido comprados por clientes do RJ é 305589.31.

questions.question: How many distinct products from the 'perfumaria' category have been sold?

sql.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS sold_perfumaria_products
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name = 'perfumaria'
  AND o.order_status = 'delivered';

questions.answer: Leitura usada: contar apenas produtos distintos da categoria perfumaria que aparecem em itens de pedidos com status "delivered". Resultado: 857 produtos distintos foram vendidos.

questions.question: How many orders were purchased in 2017?

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders_2017 FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017;

questions.answer: Leitura usada: contar apenas os pedidos cuja data de compra (order_purchase_timestamp) esteja em 2017. Em 2017 houve 45.101 pedidos.

questions.question: In which month of 2018 (as a number from 1 to 12) were the most orders purchased, and how many?

sql.query:
SELECT month, count
FROM (
  SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY month
) AS t
ORDER BY count DESC, month ASC
LIMIT 1;

questions.answer: Month 1 (January) had the most orders in 2018, with 7269 orders.
